_comment: wave 28 (gap-closing batch 4): single-temporal -> Temporal* conversions and restrictions, via the new temporal_wkb return-kind (varsized assembler serializes the Temporal* result through temporal_as_hexwkb WKB_EXTENDED, keeping the SRID) plus the wkb_temporal extra-arg now supported in the varsized path. tgeompoint_to_tgeometry uses a per-event tgeompoint instant primary; the rest carry the temporal operand as a hex literal (wkb_temporal) so the geometry-first dwithin signatures and the 3D-point elevation restrictions marshal cleanly. All probed green against v15 (instant forms; linear-sequence tgeompoint_to_tgeometry is a MEOS constraint, not exercised).

operators.comment_one_liner: tgeometry_to_tcbuffer (Temporal *) - the temporal circular buffer of a temporal geometry.
tdwithin_geo_tgeo (Temporal *) - whether a geometry is within a distance of a temporal geo, over time.
tdwithin_geo_tcbuffer (Temporal *) - whether a geometry is within a distance of a temporal buffer, over time.
tpoint_at_elevation (Temporal *) - the temporal point restricted to an elevation span.
tpoint_minus_elevation (Temporal *) - the temporal point minus an elevation span.
